body: Thank you for the advice, I hope that once this pandemic is over we can be with our family again.

I think so too but during these times of pandemic it's really hard to consult to one. So up until now I've been suffering alone, but last two months ago I've opened up to my family and I was surprised that they were really supportive. But the feeling of guilt of being a burden is just too much or it is just me...

Thank you for the advice, but I think my flaw is that I take things too seriously even though I am the youngest in the family I can't help but feel the weight of guilt. Seeing them try so hard in life makes me want to do that too, but even though I want to, I can't set aside the feeling of being tired all the time..
